ravi: Heads-up — planning a NIC/IO replacement in az23 midnight window Tue 2026-04-14 00:30-02:30 UTC. We'll do rolling reboots of 2 racks, staggered to keep capacity. Affected: preemptible and burst GPU pools. :warning:

elaine: ETA on tx impact? can we keep tail latency <100ms for critical routes?

ravi: We expect short drops during node drain (30-60s) while BGP rehashes and drivers reload. We'll cordon one rack at a time, drain pods, then reboot the host. We'll backfill with reserved pool for 10m per rack.

mike: Can we prime KV cache before resuming high traffic? last time cold cache spiked costs.

ravi: Yes — plan to seed kvcache on canary nodes and keep prefix cache warmed. Steps: 
```
kubectl cordon node-rack-5-*
kubectl drain node-rack-5-* --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
# run nvlink-safe-restart.sh
```

sophia: Who's oncall for rollback? @sam oncall? 

sam: I'm oncall that night. If rollback needed, I can flip routing to eu-reserve pool and open a hotfix rollback path.

elaine: Cost note — we'll be using reserved backfill for ~120 GPU-minutes total. Finance ok? 

zoe: finance ok, tag usage to ENG-MAINT-APR. We'll absorb spike.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance ticket #MAINT-8923 created and linked to incident. Reminder will post 30m before.

ravi: Cool. I'll publish customer comms draft to #customer-success tomorrow. Runbook updated in runbooks/az23-nic-maint.md. Please ack if good.

elaine: ack :thumbsup:

sam: ack. I'll be in channel during window.
